limitations: All six IDs were returned by the official API and still include cs.RO. An unchanged keyword admission function returning null is not a universal relevance judgement or evidence of withdrawal.
Literal-vocabulary admission is sensitive to hyphenation and wording changes; SwarmCoDe's task-planning wording demonstrates this known limitation. This refresh does not silently widen the rules.

The metadata revision dates for CARE and Plug, Play and Comply precede the previous snapshot date. Observed snapshot differences do not establish when a source index first exposed a version or why the previous harvest returned older metadata.
The complete-harvest candidate-count agreement and these targeted ID checks do not independently prove perfect candidate identities or universal semantic coverage.
Earlier dated refresh receipts remain immutable historical evidence and are not modified by this review.
